verdict.rationale: Poke supports event-driven automation via its API (external services like GitHub/CI/CD/monitoring tools can trigger Poke) and 'Recipes' that let users set up automations and integrations, plus reminders that trigger actions naturally. However, the docs don't describe a structured rule-definition engine (e.g., conditional logic, multi-step triggers) — automation is mostly limited to simple trigger-to-message flows and prebuilt recipes rather than user-defined complex rules. Missing for 10: explicit conditional/rule-builder UI, multi-event chaining, and independent evidence of complex automation working in practice.
